title: A 12-Foot Plane With No Pilot Hit Nearly 7,000 mph

scenes.text: In 2004, NASA flew a plane with no pilot at nearly seven thousand miles per hour.
It was the X-43A, a twelve-foot-long test vehicle hanging under a B-52 bomber.
A rocket carried it up to about one hundred ten thousand feet over the Pacific.
Then the X-43A fired its scramjet engine and flew on its own.
It reached Mach 9.6, nearly ten times the speed of sound. A Guinness world record.
A plane the length of a car, flying about ten times faster than sound.

description:
On November 16th, 2004, NASA's unpiloted X-43A reached Mach 9.6, nearly 7,000 miles per hour.
A Pegasus rocket carried it to about 110,000 feet before its scramjet engine took over.
Would you ride something that fast?
first_comment: How fast would you be willing to fly, 600 mph, Mach 2, or Mach 9?
